name: Tojita Sekai no Tori Colony
original_name: 閉じたセカイのトリコロニー
source:
This is the first game by Tiny Bell, a sister company of bonbon-company. 

Minato was confessed to by the new transfer student Nodoka who he had just met. This day was one that he had been longing for. There were awkward and embarrassing moments at first, but he gradually became charmed by her and enjoyed a comfortable relationship surprising to his classmates and osananajimi.

A month later, they spent the night together and they promised not to forget each other since they loved each other so much. When he woke up, he found himself back on the morning of the confession.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/07/19/july-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是bonbon-company的姊妹公司Tiny Bell的第一款游戏。

凑是被刚认识的新转校生野多香告白的。这一天，是他一直渴望的一天。起初有一些尴尬和尴尬的时刻，但他逐渐被她迷住了，并享受着令他的同学和奥萨那纳吉米惊讶的舒适关系。

一个月后，他们在一起过夜，并承诺不会忘记对方，因为他们如此相爱。当他醒来时，他发现自己又回到了忏悔的那天早上。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/07/19/july-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
